verdict.rationale: Orama's core is an open-source search library you embed and run in your own application at no cost. It provides full-text, vector and hybrid search (orama-docs-12, orama-gh-2, orama-docs-4). The docs also offer on-premise deployment of the Orama Cloud context server on your own infrastructure and API parity for migrating between Cloud and open source (orama-docs-8, orama-docs-19). However, the open-source AnswerSession relies on Orama Cloud's Secure Proxy to reach OpenAI (orama-docs-18), and on-prem appears to be a support offering rather than documented self-serve. Missing for 10: fully self-hosted AI answer path without Cloud's Secure Proxy, documented on-prem deployment/install guide, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosting.
